name: Meadow First Hop
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #5 — the gentlest teaching arena: TWO huge trampoline lawns split by ONE 580px gap, plus a boost-only bubblegum shoulder over each lawn. The whole point is to teach the very first boosted hop: a player who tries to bounce across the single gap falls into the void; a single tap of boost carries them. No throne, no hazard, no second gap to fumble — one clean lesson on forgiving 1500px landing pads.

GEOMETRY: LEFT lawn (trampoline x0..1500 top1080 h128) / RIGHT lawn (trampoline x2080..3580 top1080 h128) flank ONE 580px void gap (x1500..2080). Two bubblegum SHOULDERS (left x300..620 / right x2960..3280, both top560 h48) hover 520px above their lawn as optional high ground. One full-width lethal void (rim y1260) under the whole span; the gap renders as a canyon maw. Bounds -540..4120 give ~540px side runway; bottom y1920 leaves 712px recovery sky under the lawns.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses a 580px gap in <0.9s @ ~24 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super 2800 clears all, dumps tank):
- GAP left<->right lawn: edges x1500..x2080 = 580px over open void. > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395 (trampoline drift). NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; a bounce-hop drifts ~395px and drops into the void. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to either SHOULDER (top560): 520px above the lawn top (1080). Trampoline apex 270 reaches only y810 -> 270px short; the bubblegum shoulder itself has no higher launch. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: lawn bottom (1208) to bottom blast (1920) = 712px of open sky over the chasm (>= 650) -> a fuelled knock-off boosts back; a near-brink dead-on smash rings out. Verb: FLY.
- No bounce route crosses the gap or reaches a shoulder, so flight is required to move up or across. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
